name: resu-studio
description: Tailor a CV and cover letter to one job advertisement, honestly. Scores what the advertisement asks for against what the person has actually done, proposes every change as current text, suggested text and a reason for them to accept or reject one at a time, and prints a finished PDF exactly as the studio shows it.

interface.shortDescription: Tailor a CV and cover letter to one job ad, honestly
interface.longDescription: Scores what the advertisement asks for against what you have actually done, before changing anything. Proposes every change as current text, suggested text and a reason, for you to accept or reject one at a time, then prints a PDF a screening system can still read.
defaultPrompt: Help me tailor my CV to this job ad
Am I a good fit for this role?
Write a cover letter for this application
